    base == "" ? instId_manual : (quote == "" ? (base + "-USDT") : (base + "-" + quote))

string INST_ID = (instId_mode == "MANUAL") ? instId_manual : f_instId_auto()

f_meta() =>
    include_meta ? (",\"ticker\":\"" + syminfo.ticker + "\",\"tf\":\"" + timeframe.period + "\",\"ts\":\"" + str.tostring(time) + "\"") : ""

// [FIX] alert_id??"?ъ쟾???ъ떆???먯꽌???숈씪?댁빞 idempotency媛 ?숈옉?⑸땲??

// Ichimoku (displacement ?놁씠 "?꾩옱媛??쇰줈留??ъ슜)
htf_tenkan = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htf_tf, (ta.highest(high, ichi_tenkan) + ta.lowest(low, ichi_tenkan)) / 2.0, barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)

htf_senkouA= request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htf_tf, ((ta.highest(high, ichi_tenkan) + ta.lowest(low, ichi_tenkan))/2.0 + (ta.highest(high, ichi_kijun) + ta.lowest(low, ichi_kijun))/2.0) / 2.0, barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)
htf_senkouB= request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htf_tf, (ta.highest(high, ichi_senkou) + ta.lowest(low, ichi_senkou)) / 2.0, barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)

cloud_upper = math.max(htf_senkouA, htf_senkouB)
cloud_lower = math.min(htf_senkouA, htf_senkouB)
cloud_bull  = htf_senkouA > htf_senkouB
cloud_bear  = htf_senkouA < htf_senkouB

// Supertrend (HTF)
f_htf_st(_factor, _len) =>
    [st, dir] = ta.supertrend(_factor, _len)
    st
f_htf_st_dir(_factor, _len) =>
    [st, dir] = ta.supertrend(_factor, _len)
    dir

htf_st     = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htf_tf, f_htf_st(st_factor, st_len), barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)

st_dir_fixed = invert_st_dir ? -htf_st_dir : htf_st_dir

// smoother
smoother_F(src, len) =>
    float a = 2.0 / (len + 1)
    float b = 1 - a
    var float out = na
    out := na(out[1]) ? src : a * src + b * out[1]
    out

// std array (?먮낯 援ъ“ 蹂댁〈??
float[] std_array = array.new<float>(len_std)

float line_long  = smoother_F(close, len_smooth * 2)
float line_short = smoother_F(close, len_smooth)
float oscillator = line_short - line_long

float stdev_osc  = ta.stdev(oscillator, len_std)
